title: AI Story Challenge
description: Pick a hero, a place and a theme – the AI storyteller writes a campus adventure just for you.

badges.title: Campus Storyteller
badges.description: You created an AI campus story!

templates: One bright morning, {character} walked into the {place} at {schoolName}. Something unusual was waiting there: {theme}! With a notebook in hand and a head full of questions, they looked closer, asked for help from friends, and slowly put the clues together. By the end of the day, everyone in the {place} was smiling – because the best discoveries happen when we are curious together.

Nobody expected {character} to appear in the {place} that afternoon. But there they were, ready for {theme}. Step by step, they tried an idea, failed, laughed, and tried again. When the school bell finally rang, the {place} felt different – brighter, braver and full of possibility. And that was just the beginning.

Legend says that whenever {character} visits the {place}, adventure follows. Today's adventure was {theme}. Using kindness, teamwork and a little bit of science, the mission was a success. As the sun set over {schoolName}, {character} whispered, "Tomorrow, let's explore even further."
